slides.texte_overlay:
how to stay calm
under pressure

breathe out longer

when pressure hits, make every breath out longer than the breath in. it slows your heart rate in seconds and tells your body that you're safe enough to think.

shrink the problem

ask yourself what the very next small step is, and only focus on that. huge problems feel lighter the moment you stop trying to solve all of them at once.

talk slower

under stress, everyone speeds up. speaking a little slower on purpose makes you sound in control, and somehow it makes you actually feel more in control too.

train a calm mind daily

calm under pressure is built on ordinary days, by giving your mind a few quiet minutes of learning each day. a calm, curious mind is much harder to rattle when things get hard.

slides.texte_overlay:
remember past storms

think of a hard moment you already got through. reminding yourself that you've survived difficult days before makes this one feel far less frightening.
